aboutContent.storyTitle: ENGINEERING FOR THE HEAVY DEMANDS OF COMMERCIAL CATERING & CONFECTIONERY
aboutContent.storyText: SHRI DURGA STEELS stands as an established enterprise with two distinct operational divisions: Commercial Kitchen Equipment & Appliances for restaurants and hotels, alongside our in-house Manufacturing Facility producing certified food-grade stainless steel trays, confectioner hardware, and custom banqueting equipment.
aboutContent.approachText: Every piece of equipment and fabricated tray is planned for intense duty cycles, seamless cleaning, and long-term serviceability. We reject flimsy, short-lived components in favor of certified non-magnetic stainless steel alloys and industrial-grade heating components.
aboutContent.productsTitle: DUAL DIVISIONS: APPLIANCES & IN-HOUSE STAINLESS HARDWARE
aboutContent.productsText: Our commercial appliances cover precision induction ranges, continuous fryers, contact grills, pizza deck ovens, and heavy steamers. Simultaneously, our manufacturing facility stamps, deep-draws, and hand-finishes over 40 varieties of Barfi, Rasgulla, and Sandesh trays, spice consoles, and PVD titanium luxury hardware.
aboutContent.customersText: Trusted by 5-star & 7-star hotel banquet operations, renowned traditional sweet brands, fast-growing restaurant chains, commercial cloud kitchens, and institutional caterers across India and overseas.
aboutContent.commitmentText: 100% bench quality testing, certified food-grade metallurgy, transparent B2B pricing with structured dealer margins, and responsive sales & factory support desks.
